purpose: Chọn dữ liệu có nguồn gốc rõ ràng cho nghiên cứu độ chân thật, pose và fit của JAPANO; không tự động cấp quyền dùng thương mại.

sources.name: VITON-HD
sources.license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 on the downloaded Kaggle package; canonical repository is CC-BY-NC-4.0
sources.decision: Use only for offline upper-body research and disjoint evaluation; never claim coverage of the whole catalog.

sources.name: StreetTryOn
sources.license: inherits DeepFashion2 and VITON-HD; no commercial use
sources.decision: Best next external realism benchmark after access is approved; do not fetch from an unofficial mirror.

sources.name: Dress Code
sources.license: signed release agreement; non-institutional email rejected; not released to private companies
limits: not automatically usable by an ecommerce product
sources.decision: Request through the school only if the thesis supervisor accepts the terms.

sources.name: FIT-VTO 100K preview
limits: NoDerivatives makes training/redistribution of derived adapters unsuitable without written permission
sources.decision: Do not train or activate a checkpoint from it until written permission clarifies derivative-model use.

sources.name: SOMASet
limits: may reduce photorealism if used as direct image target
sources.decision: Useful for pose/contact stress tests, not selected as a photorealistic VTON training target.

sources.name: People Clothing Segmentation
sources.license: CC0 declared by Kaggle uploader; upstream image provenance still needs review
limits: mirror provenance not sufficient for production training
sources.decision: Potential parsing evaluation only after upstream rights are verified.

currentDecision.trainableNow: Existing VITON-HD supports the already completed upper-body academic LoRA experiment only.
currentDecision.doNotRetrainReason: Repeating training on the same 116 mostly synthetic fit targets would not add realism or category coverage.
currentDecision.nextDataGate: Obtain written school access to StreetTryOn/DeepFashion2 or collect consented JAPANO person-garment-target captures with identity-disjoint splits.
